places.name: Tirthan Valley & Gushaini
places.description: A serene and pristine alpine sanctuary in Kullu, known for its crystal-clear glacial trout streams, towering cedar pines, traditional Kath-Kuni hamlets, and direct trails into the UNESCO Great Himalayan National Park.

nearby_locations.name: Great Himalayan National Park Gate
nearby_locations.description: Pristine bio-reserve home to endangered Western Tragopans, leopards, and virgin cedar glades.

nearby_locations.name: Chhoie Sacred Waterfall Trail
nearby_locations.description: Hidden deodar forest hike leading to a thundering icy cascade honored by village elders.

nearby_locations.name: Sharchi Kath-Kuni Ridge Village
nearby_locations.description: Ancient stone-and-cedar ridge village perched on the canyon rim overlooking snow ranges.

nearby_locations.name: Tirthan River Angling Pool
nearby_locations.description: Cobblestone riverbanks where Himalayan brown trout thrive in clear glacial rapids.

stay_options.name: Riverside Cedar Homestay
stay_options.tagline: Handcrafted cedar wood chalet perched right over crystalline trout waters
stay_options.description: Wake up to river melodies in warm cedar suites. Enjoy slow-cooked Himachali thalis, river trout barbecue, and private sitting lawns by the water.

stay_options.name: Apple Orchard Cottage Sharchi
stay_options.tagline: Stone and cedar cottage nestled amidst organic red royal apple orchards
stay_options.description: Perched 2,200m high in the historic ridge hamlet of Sharchi with unmatched views of the Tirthan canyon and snow-dusted peaks.

stay_options.name: Pine Forest Eco Camp
stay_options.tagline: Waterproof luxury bell tents surrounded by aromatic deodar pine forests
stay_options.description: Cozy bell tents with plush mattresses, attached modern washrooms, and nightly campfires with acoustic Himachali melodies under the stars.

stay_options.name: Himalayan Wooden Chalet Bandal
stay_options.tagline: Handcrafted Kath-Kuni wooden retreat offering dramatic gorge vistas
stay_options.description: Built with interlocking deodar timbers and native slate. Warm, cozy rooms facing the Great Himalayan National Park mountain passes.

places.name: Jibhi & Shoja Pine Ridge
places.description: Tucked under dense pine forests in Kullu, Jibhi and Shoja are renowned for multi-century Kath-Kuni fort towers, cascading hidden waterfalls, crystal forest streams, and high passes overlooking the snow-crested Great Himalayas.

nearby_locations.name: Jibhi Hidden Waterfall & Bridges
nearby_locations.description: Enchanted turquoise cascade accessible via miniature wooden footbridges through deodar groves.

nearby_locations.name: Chehni Kothi 1500-Yr Fort Tower
nearby_locations.description: Towering 45-meter earthquake-resistant stone-and-timber defensive watchtower in Kullu.

nearby_locations.name: Jalori Pass & Serolsar Lake (3,120m)
nearby_locations.description: High mountain pass leading to the sacred Serolsar Lake guarded by goddess Budhi Nagin.

nearby_locations.name: Shringi Rishi Pagoda Shrine
nearby_locations.description: Revered multi-tiered wood pagoda honoring the patron deity of the Banjar valley.

stay_options.name: Kath-Kuni Cedar Heritage Chalet
stay_options.tagline: Centuries-old slate and cedar mansion beside singing forest streams
stay_options.description: Stay in a genuine multi-story Himachali wood mansion. Fragrant cedar wood walls, private attic balconies, and steaming homemade Siddu with pure ghee.

stay_options.name: Jibhi Stream-Side Pine Cottage
stay_options.tagline: Charming stone cottage nestled right where the forest stream meets the waterfall trail
stay_options.description: Wake up to bubbling waters and birdsong. Features private wooden decks, campfire pits, and fresh local organic food.

stay_options.name: Shoja Pine Ridge Chalet
stay_options.tagline: Panoramic mountain pass chalet offering sunrise views of snow-dusted Dhauladhars
stay_options.description: Perched high on the Shoja ridge edge. Glass windows framing pine canopies, cozy wood stoves, and hearty Kullu thali dinners.

stay_options.name: Wildflower Jibhi Campsite
stay_options.tagline: Peaceful forest clearing glamping campsite beside alpine deodars
stay_options.description: Unplug beneath a star-filled canopy. Comfortable bell tents, warm sleeping bags, and nightly acoustic bonfires.

places.name: Sainj Valley & Shangarh Meadows
places.description: Arguably the most magical offbeat meadow in Kullu district. Shangarh is an emerald alpine pasture sacred to Sangchul Mahadev, surrounded by deodar pine walls, hidden glacial waterfalls, and pristine birdwatching trails into Sainj wildlife sanctuary.

nearby_locations.name: The Sacred Shangarh Meadow
nearby_locations.description: Mythological emerald meadow free of stones, believed to have been prepared by the Pandavas.

nearby_locations.name: Barshangarh Hidden Waterfall
nearby_locations.description: Deep jungle trail leading to a hidden glacial waterfall surrounded by mossy boulders.

nearby_locations.name: Sangchul Mahadev Kath-Kuni Shrine
nearby_locations.description: Historic woodcarved temple with multi-tiered slate roof standing watch over the meadow.

nearby_locations.name: Pundrik Rishi Sacred Lake
nearby_locations.description: Serene sacred lake covered in floating water grasses nestled inside dense deodars.

stay_options.name: Shangarh Meadow View Cedar Homestay
stay_options.tagline: Authentic Kath-Kuni home perched right on the edge of the sacred Shangarh meadow
stay_options.description: Step out directly into the grassy expanse. Cozy cedar rooms, hot homemade Rajma-Madra, fresh cow milk tea, and peaceful starry skies.

stay_options.name: Barshangarh Pine Chalet
stay_options.tagline: Quiet timber cottage nestled near the gushing waterfall stream and apple trees
stay_options.description: Far from roads and noise. A cozy mountain cabin with private cedar balcony looking over dense deodar pine slopes and apple orchards.

stay_options.name: Sainj Valley River Cottage
stay_options.tagline: Riverside stone-and-slate cottage at the gateway to Sainj Wildlife Sanctuary
stay_options.description: Wake to the rushing sound of Sainj river. Enjoy organic farm vegetables, guided nature walks, and genuine Kullu village warmth.

stay_options.name: Divine Meadow Mud House
stay_options.tagline: Eco-restored traditional mud-and-timber house with 360-degree views of Sainj range
stay_options.description: Traditional mud plaster keeps rooms naturally insulated and warm. Enjoy cozy wood-fired Bukhari stoves, herbal tea blends, and starry night skies.

places.name: Kalga & Pulga (Parvati Tri-Villages)
places.description: Perched high on sunny mountain rims in Kullu, Kalga, Pulga and Tulga are peaceful car-free hamlets surrounded by organic apple orchards, the enchanted ancient Fairy Forest, and tranquil pine trails leading up to Kheerganga and Kutla.

nearby_locations.name: Pulga Ancient Fairy Forest
nearby_locations.description: Dense mossy deodar woodland with century-old roots, hidden tea houses, and mountain mist.

nearby_locations.name: Kalga Golden Apple Orchards
nearby_locations.description: Car-free trails through aromatic apple trees, chamomile fields, and traditional fences.

nearby_locations.name: Kheerganga Thermal Bath Trail
nearby_locations.description: Famous natural hot spring bath plateau surrounded by snow peaks and glacial waterfalls.

nearby_locations.name: Kutla High Alpine Meadow
nearby_locations.description: Hidden pastoral meadow above Tosh river with direct views of snow spires and glacial tarns.

stay_options.name: Kalga Apple Orchard Wooden Lodge
stay_options.tagline: Rustic orchard retreat with glacier views, sourdough bakes and herbal infusions
stay_options.description: Perched above the valley floor in peaceful Kalga. Wooden rooms, herbal tea foraging, and serene writing spaces with panoramic glacier backdrops.

stay_options.name: Pulga Fairy Forest Cedar Homestay
stay_options.tagline: Traditional wooden house situated on the gateway to the enchanted fairy forest
stay_options.description: Step straight into the fairy woods. Relax on the sun terrace with freshly brewed chai, savor organic rajma-chawal, and sleep in cedar-scented quiet.

stay_options.name: Kalga Sunrise Horizon Chalet
stay_options.tagline: Boutique timber chalet perched at the highest point of Kalga with 270° snow peaks
stay_options.description: Uninterrupted sunrise over snow peaks. Enjoy artisan baked goods, fresh apple jams, wood-fired hearths, and stargazing from the open meadow.

stay_options.name: Tulga Heritage Farm House
stay_options.tagline: Quiet authentic Pahadi farmhouse surrounded by mountain barley and apricot trees
stay_options.description: True immersion into authentic mountain rhythm. Fresh cow milk, home-ground flour, organic greens, and peaceful starry skies.

places.name: Chalal & Katagla Riverside
places.description: Cross the wooden suspension footbridge into quiet deodar pine groves. Chalal and Katagla are the peaceful offbeat riverside counterparts in Kullu, free from vehicular traffic, featuring hammock gardens, artisan bakeries, and turquoise river currents.

nearby_locations.name: Chalal Suspension Footbridge
nearby_locations.description: Wooden suspension bridge crossing roaring turquoise rapids into peaceful pine woods.

nearby_locations.name: Katagla Riverside Pebble Island
nearby_locations.description: Pebbled river clearing where travellers read books to the rush of mountain waters.

nearby_locations.name: Grahan Ancient Honey Trail
nearby_locations.description: Deep deodar trek leading to the secluded mountain village known for organic mountain honey.

nearby_locations.name: Manikaran Natural Hot Sulphur Springs
nearby_locations.description: Famous natural mineral hot sulphur springs alongside the historic Gurudwara in Kullu.

stay_options.name: Chalal Riverside Bell Tents
stay_options.tagline: Riverside glamping beneath tall deodars with hammocks and wood-fired oven pizzas
stay_options.description: Escape to the tranquil bank of Chalal. Geodesic dome tents, hammocks over clear glacial water, acoustic evening bonfires, and stargazing.

stay_options.name: Parvati Pine Wood Chalet
stay_options.tagline: Handcrafted pine wood chalets overlooking the roaring rapids of Parvati River
stay_options.description: Cozy timber cabins hidden among fragrant pine trees. Hot cinnamon tea, fresh apple strudel, and quiet riverside reading spots.

stay_options.name: Katagla Eco Glamping Sanctuary
stay_options.tagline: Peaceful off-grid riverside sanctuary across the wooden suspension bridge
stay_options.description: Pure wilderness by the river. Large canvas safari tents, pebble river bathing, and acoustic gatherings under starry deodars.

stay_options.name: Rasol Trailhead Homestay
stay_options.tagline: Rustic hillside retreat on the trailhead to hidden mountain hamlets
stay_options.description: Enjoy peaceful farm views away from vehicles. Home-cooked vegetarian delicacies, spacious wooden rooms, and breathtaking sunset peaks.

places.name: Naggar & Hallan Valley
places.description: The ancient cultural capital of Kullu kings. Featuring the 500-year-old Kath-Kuni wood castle, the heritage artist village of Rumsu, the traditional Jana waterfall feast, and the secluded, untouched Hallan Valley rising through high cedar pine groves.

nearby_locations.name: 500-Yr Naggar Kath-Kuni Castle
nearby_locations.description: Medieval fortress of Kullu kings built with interlocking stone and cedar without mortar.

nearby_locations.name: Hallan Valley Hidden Cedar Ridge
nearby_locations.description: Untouched mountain bowl with ancient deodars, red apple orchards, and zero commercial noise.

nearby_locations.name: Jana Waterfall & Traditional Feast
nearby_locations.description: Historic mountain cascade famous for native wood-chulha Siddu, Makki ki roti, and lingri pickles.

nearby_locations.name: Rumsu 1000-Yr Heritage Hamlet
nearby_locations.description: Traditional Kath-Kuni wooden village and start of the historic Chandrakhani Pass trail.

stay_options.name: Naggar Heritage Kath-Kuni Chalet
stay_options.tagline: Centuries-old family estate looking across the Beas valley and Dhauladhar snowcaps
stay_options.description: Historic wood carvings, cozy stone hearths, traditional Kullu Dham banquets, and serene terraces facing snowy mountain ranges.

stay_options.name: Hallan Valley Orchard Retreat
stay_options.tagline: Hidden ridge retreat nestled inside the peaceful, unexplored Hallan Valley
stay_options.description: Discover Kullu's best-kept secret. Wake up surrounded by dense deodar canopies, red apple trees, and silence broken only by birds.

stay_options.name: Rumsu Pine Forest Homestay
stay_options.tagline: Authentic village home on the ancient Chandrakhani Pass shepherd route
stay_options.description: Experience authentic rural life in Rumsu. Traditional slate roofs, warm family meals cooked over wood fires, and local trail stories.

stay_options.name: Jana Cedar Wood Lodge
stay_options.tagline: Cedar wood lodge perched beside century-old deodars and natural mineral springs
stay_options.description: Enjoy peaceful mountain silence. Delicious traditional culinary experiences, fresh mountain spring water, and walks through mossy pine canopies.

places.name: Waichin Valley (Magic Valley)
places.description: A mystical, off-grid high alpine valley hidden beyond the Malana dam in Kullu. Towering beneath the rugged Shadow Mountain, Waichin offers pure glacial streams, starlit silence, zero motor roads, and breathtaking panoramas of the snow-crowned Himalayas.

nearby_locations.name: Shadow Mountain Ridge View
nearby_locations.description: Colossal rocky spire casting mystical afternoon shadows across the alpine valley.

nearby_locations.name: Waichin Glacial River Confluence
nearby_locations.description: Pristine glacial river formed by melting snows from high passes above Kullu.

nearby_locations.name: Twin Glacial Waterfalls
nearby_locations.description: Twin roaring cascades tumbling down granite rockfaces into wildflower meadows.

nearby_locations.name: Malana Gorge Overlook
nearby_locations.description: Dramatic rim view into the world-famous isolationist plateau of ancient Malana.

stay_options.name: Waichin Magic Valley Glamping Camp
stay_options.tagline: Weatherproof high-altitude glamping beneath the towering peaks of Waichin
stay_options.description: Unplug from the modern world. Cozy insulated bell tents, roaring wood fires, homemade ginger-honey tea, and Bortle-1 Milky Way skies at 2,700m.

stay_options.name: Shadow Mountain High Cabin
stay_options.tagline: Handcrafted stone-and-timber cabin with front-row view of the jagged Shadow Peak
stay_options.description: Built using native mountain stone. Warm wood stove, hearty thukpas and momos, and incredible morning light hitting the highest ridges of Kullu.

stay_options.name: Waichin Stream Cedar Homestay
stay_options.tagline: Rustic wooden shelter situated right beside the bubbling glacial stream
stay_options.description: True off-grid Himalayan simplicity. Clean cozy bedding, fresh water directly from glacial springs, and starry firesides.

stay_options.name: Starlight Meadow Expedition Dome
stay_options.tagline: Expedition geodesic dome with transparent ceiling for night sky astrophotography
stay_options.description: Sleep under the Milky Way at 2,700 meters. Designed specifically for stargazers, trekkers, and nature photographers looking for raw Himalayan wilderness.

places.name: Lug Valley & Mathasaur
places.description: One of the rawest and least commercialized valleys in Kullu. Lug Valley stretches along ancient forest corridors dotted with traditional watermills (Gharat), multi-tiered wooden shrines, sacred alpine ponds like Mathasaur, and virgin deodar woodlands completely untouched by tourism.

nearby_locations.name: Mathasaur Sacred Alpine Tarn
nearby_locations.description: Sacred mountain pond nestled in rhododendron forests honored by native Kullu shepherds.

nearby_locations.name: Traditional Himalayan Gharat Mills
nearby_locations.description: Historic water-powered stone grain mills operating on glacial streams since centuries.

nearby_locations.name: Lug Valley Wild Rhododendron Ridge
nearby_locations.description: Dense scarlet and pink rhododendron ridge walks with views across the Kullu valley.

nearby_locations.name: Tihar Ancient Cedar Village
nearby_locations.description: Authentic multi-story wooden village with Kath-Kuni carvings and stone courtyards.

stay_options.name: Lug Valley Pine River Retreat
stay_options.tagline: Quiet timber cottage situated along the Sarvari river in unexplored Lug Valley
stay_options.description: Far from crowds in pure forest peace. Cozy wooden rooms, freshly caught mountain stream fish, organic farm greens, and starry night bonfires.

stay_options.name: Mathasaur Trailhead Wooden Chalet
stay_options.tagline: Handcrafted alpine chalet at the gateway to sacred high-altitude alpine ponds
stay_options.description: Situated where village roads end and pure deodar forest begins. Enjoy crackling wood hearths, fresh cow milk chai, and guided forest hikes.

stay_options.name: Deodar Canopy Shepherd Homestay
stay_options.tagline: Authentic pastoral stone home tucked under giant cedar canopies
stay_options.description: True mountain hospitality. Stone hearth cooking, fresh honey from native beehives, handmade woolen blankets, and unhurried village days.

stay_options.name: Himalayan Gharat Eco Camp
stay_options.tagline: Offbeat riverside camp beside ancient operational stone watermills
stay_options.description: Experience the magic of traditional watermills. Camp under star-studded pine trees, taste fresh bread made with watermill-ground flour, and enjoy quiet campfires.

places.name: Tashi Mountain Retreat
places.tagline: Authentic sanctuary hosted by Tashi Dorje
places.description: Traditional stone retreat overlooking Tirthan trout stream.

experiences.title: Hidden Cedar Forest Walk
experiences.description: Gentle walking trail through ancient deodar pine glades with secret waterfall nooks.

experiences.title: Authentic Himachali Home Meal
experiences.description: Traditional Siddu, ghee, mountain walnut chutney, and wood-fired dham lunch.

experiences.title: Sunrise Viewpoint Ridge Trek
experiences.description: Ascend to high alpine ridges overlooking snowcapped Great Himalayan peaks at golden dawn.

experiences.title: Village Life & Handloom Walk
experiences.description: Discover Kath-Kuni heritage architecture, traditional wool weaving, and organic apple orchards.

experiences.title: Riverside Camping & Stargazing
experiences.description: Sleep under pristine dark skies beside the bubbling glacial Tirthan stream with bonfire warmth.

locals.name: Rahul Sharma
locals.bio: Born in Shoja near Jalori Pass, Rahul has guided wanderers through ancient cedar forests and waterfall alcoves for over 7 years.

locals.name: Sonia Negi
locals.bio: Sonia loves introducing mindful wanderers to organic farming, trout river walks, and centuries-old Kath-Kuni wooden architecture in Gushaini.

locals.name: Vikram Thakur
locals.bio: Native to Kullu valley, Vikram knows every ancient stone temple, apple harvest route, and ridge overlook.

bookings.provider_notes: Looking forward to guiding you along the Jalori ridge.
